== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3952]] is assessed at 84% (probable). Annie and William share a specific 1867 original-marriage pointer in their dossiers, and 1838 birth fits a young 1820 father. This strongly suggests William is the father defined by that marriage, but the held packet supplies no transcription of its father column.

Selected Glasgow-3952 fatherhood of Glasgow-3951; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Transcribe Annie's 1867 marriage father, occupation and residence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1867/11507/8231940.pdf https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1867/11507/8231940.pdf].
